text:
Hana: Quick one-pager ask for the webinar follow-up. Audience = platform security + procurement. Needs: a clear deployment-mode decision strip (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), two safe benchmark callouts (no raw numbers), and a gated lead-routing CTA so SDRs can slot inbound. Keep it one column, scannable, and legal-safe.
Cole: I can take copy + wire. Proposal: topline header, three stacked cards, a 3-row micro-table, and a tiny SDR routing form preview. Use phrasing like 'low p95 latency profiles' and 'meaningful unit-cost improvement with batching' instead of exact figures.
Priya: Also include a 3-bullet buyer-signals checklist for SDRs: data residency, SLA requirement, and peak throughput band. That helps routing to Dedicated/Private lanes.
Mason: Security checks: no vendor KMS names, no promises of turnkey air-gapped installs. Safe line: 'Configurable networking, KMS integrations, and audit logging.' Add legal footnote: 'Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns.'
Hana: Good. Also make sure any benchmark reference links to our canonical hub (marketing-benchmarks v3) and requires Ops sign-off.
Ops-Bot: Reminder: benchmark citations must include hub ID MB-2024-09 and Ops sign-off tag @ops before publish.
Cole: Draft copy below — please reply with edits. I kept it short for a one-pager layout.

```
Secure inference: pick the deployment that fits your controls

Hosted — Fastest time-to-value
- Why: API-first hosted inference for rapid feature validation and prototypes.
- Security: Shared infrastructure, tenant isolation, RBAC.
- Good for: early-stage products and experiments.

Dedicated — Predictable capacity & SLAs
- Why: Reserved GPU pools and autoscale for steady production workloads.
- Security: Data-isolated capacity and enhanced access controls.
- Good for: teams scaling to production with SLA needs.

Private — Compliance-first control
- Why: VPC or on-prem options with audit logging and customer KMS integrations.
- Security: Network isolation and enterprise policy enforcement.
- Good for: regulated and security-sensitive customers.

Micro-compare (Security | SLA | Typical buyer)
- Hosted: Shared controls | Best-effort latency | Prototype teams
- Dedicated: Isolated pools | SLA-backed | Growing product teams
- Private: Full control | Configurable SLAs | Regulated orgs

Benchmarks: See MB-2024-09 (marketing benchmark hub) for latency profiles by model/region and cost comparison notes. Performance varies by model, hardware, and prompt patterns.

SDR triage (form preview):
- Data residency required? [Yes / No]
- SLA required? [Yes / No]
- Peak throughput preference: [<5k tokens/min | 5k-50k | >50k]

Routing CTA: Book a deployment review (shortlink: redwood.ai/route) — captures buyer signals and routes to the correct sales lane.

Legal footnote: Performance and unit costs vary by model, hardware, and workload. Contact Sales for private deployment packaging; options vary by customer.
```

Priya: Love the SDR triage form preview; please change the throughput bands to '<2k | 2k-20k | >20k' — that's what SDRs use.
Cole: Updated.
Mason: Approved on security verbiage with the Ops-Bot caveat.
Ops-Bot: Tagging @ops for sign-off. Please include MB-2024-09 link in the final PDF and get an Ops ack before sending to webinar attendees.
SDR-Bot: Note for SDRs: use the triage answers to route to lanes: Hosted (self-serve), Dedicated (AE + Solutions), Private (Enterprise).
Hana: Owner: Cole. Reviewers: @Priya, @Mason, @ops. Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow AM, PDF final by EOD Friday. Thanks all!
